quest.title: Floral Fresh
quest.description: Flowers don't stay fresh for long. Flora, the owner of the Floral Whisper, has been thinking of ways to preserve them better...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: These flowers aren't looking so good, either. What a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Well, lots of people tend to buy single flowers to give as gifts, so I usually cut some flowers specifically for that purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But the flowers I trim don't stay fresh for long. If they don't sell out, they'll wilt...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I've tried many methods in the past, but the flowers degrade by the end of the day all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I wonder if there's any way to preserve those flowers for longer...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I've heard Sara from Good Hunter say that they put unused ingredients in a cool place, or preserve them using blocks of ice...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I've tried these methods too, but flowers stored using ice blocks always end up looking weird.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: They won't have withered, but I wouldn't call them fresh either... and either way, they wouldn't be presentable anymore...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I asked a lot of people, and Mr. Sayid... You know who he is, right? He's that researcher.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: One day, when he came to buy flowers, he told me that he once read about putting flowers in cold storage in a book.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Specifically... it involves using a container to store the flowers before placing that container near blocks of ice...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: He also mentioned that if I wanted to do some experiments, the most suitable place would be the low-temperature environment on Dragonspine.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: But I've heard that Dragonspine's a very dangerous place, and I couldn't find any adventurers willing to help me on such short notice...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Traveler, could you help me bury these three flower containers in the Dragonspine snow?

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Thanks for your help. Let me think... I've heard that Dragonspine is huge, and has a lot of different regions, which could lead to very different results...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Perhaps a comparison might be in order...

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Please help me place these flowers <color=#00E1FFFF>beside the Statue of The Seven</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>beside the water</color>, and... <color=#00E1FFFF>at a cavern entrance</color>, then.

choices.text: Best to sell them all on the day itself, then.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: That would be best. But there are always one or two flowers that don't get sold.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I know it's only one or two, but I don't want to just let them wither away.

talks.objective: Head to Dragonspine's Statue of The Seven and place a package there

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Snugly underground.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Thank you. We'll leave them there on the mountain for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks so much for helping me out. Please, take these for your trouble.

talks.objective: Head to Dragonspine and place a package beside a body of water
Head to the mountain cavern on Dragonspine and place a package there

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Eh? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I broke the containers and flowers by accident...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: B—By accident!?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ugh... I specifically picked those flowers out. You can't find such good flowers just anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Is Dragonspine so dangerous that even an adventurer like you couldn't keep one container from...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Still, thanks for making that trip for me. Please take these as thanks. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go tend to my flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I should try the method that Sara suggested after all...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Mr. Sayid really knows a lot. I wonder, do people keep flowers at Sumeru Akademiya too?
